mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts and retail sales indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, triggering a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue expectations are revised downward, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle economic regime characterized by slowing job growth and rising unemployment, a combination of UNRATE above 5.0% and PAYEMS growth below 0.5% annually signals an impending recession, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: late-cycle expansion with slowing labor market
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0% and PAYEMS growth < 0.5% annually, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past month indicates a contraction in manufacturing and industrial activity, reducing corporate earnings expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 500.0 (thousands of units), it signals a weakening in the residential construction sector and broader consumer confidence, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 500.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in CPIAUCSL above 3.0% and a decline in FEDFUNDS below 0.1% signals a policy response to inflation, typically leading to a temporary market correction and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0 and FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-growth economic regime, a decline in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.0% annually signals a potential slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth < 1.0% in a high-growth regime, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
